name: Edward S. Allen
bio: Edward S. Allen was listed as the plaintiff's attorney in a Morton County sheriff's sale notice that ran from May to June 1886. In September 1886 a letter to the Cow Boy signed by F. B. & E. S. Allen, attorneys for the N. P. Refrigerator Car Co., corrected the paper's report on the company's tax suits.
